sections.title: The problem with how most Bhopal businesses buy marketing
sections.content:
A typical story we hear: one freelancer runs Instagram, another “does SEO”, a nephew built the website, and Google Ads were tried once and stopped. Nobody connects the numbers, so nobody knows which rupee produced which enquiry.

The fix is not doing more channels. It is choosing the two or three that suit your business, tracking every lead back to its source, and moving budget to what works.

sections.title: How we pick your channel mix
sections.content:
Different Bhopal businesses need very different plans. Three examples of how we would start:

A dental clinic in Arera Colony: Google Business Profile and local SEO first, Google Ads on high-value treatments like implants, review generation every week. Instagram is secondary.

A coaching institute in MP Nagar: Meta ads timed around admission seasons, Google Ads for course searches, reels featuring real faculty, and a landing page per course.

A real estate project on Hoshangabad Road: Google Ads and Meta lead campaigns with strict lead qualification, a project microsite, and retargeting for site-visit bookings.

We will tell you if a channel is not worth your money yet. For many small businesses under a tight budget, that means starting with Google Maps alone.

faqs.q: What does a digital marketing agency do?
faqs.a: A digital marketing agency plans and runs your online marketing: search engine optimisation, paid ads on Google and social media, content, websites and reputation management. A good agency also sets up tracking, so you know how many leads and sales each channel produces and where to spend more or less.

faqs.q: Which digital marketing channel is best for a small business in Bhopal?
faqs.a: For most local businesses, Google Business Profile and local SEO give the best long-term return because they capture people already searching nearby. Google Ads works when you need leads quickly. Instagram and Meta ads suit businesses that sell visually or run seasonal offers, such as salons, cafes and coaching institutes.

faqs.q: Should I choose SEO or Google Ads?
faqs.a: Google Ads brings leads within days but stops when you stop paying. SEO takes 3 to 6 months to build but keeps producing enquiries without per-click costs. Many Bhopal businesses start with Google Ads for immediate leads while SEO builds, then reduce ad spend as organic leads grow.

faqs.q: How do you measure digital marketing results?
faqs.a: We track calls, WhatsApp clicks, form enquiries and, where possible, sales from each channel using call tracking and Google Analytics 4. Every month you get a short report showing leads, cost per lead and what changed, so decisions are based on numbers rather than likes or impressions.
We ask for an initial three-month commitment, because SEO and ad optimisation need time to show real results. After that, plans continue month to month. [[VERIFY contract terms]]
